column2: I took the long way round. It's fairly quiet out front today.
Still worried about being followed?
Until I have those materials, I need to be careful. Keep doing business as usual. Don't draw attention.
Someone stopped me at the junction and asked me to fix his radio.
Did you take the job?
No. The fee wasn't worth standing in the street with everyone watching.
They've put in new toll gates on the way here. The old ones are still there, still charging.
The Lower Levels never waste any time.
One payment at each gate. At least they remembered that part of the handover.
I've put your metal to use. I can finally stay in one place for a few days.
So you're safe now?
I haven't seen them lately. Enough time to get things done, but I'm not getting careless.
Someone offered me a brooch. The price would cover a month's rent down below.
Did you buy it?
No. He thought I was some visitor desperate to look rich.
I checked a few shops. One charges half as much again for the same perfume.
Different packaging?
Even the label was identical. Their assistant just opens the door for you.
A middleman insisted he wasn't in that line of work until he took the goods. Then he said I could call any time.
That was a quick change of heart.
As long as he gets things done. I'm not looking for a friend.
The food cart downstairs has a new sign. It sells 'traditional handmade synthetic soup' now.
Have you tried it?
Yes. A little more salt than the commissary's, at twice the price.
That customer was smiling on the way out. Good deal today?
Maybe he thinks he got a bargain.
Let him. As long as you didn't lose money.
How is that capped core working out? Tell me if anything gives you trouble.
Worried you made it wrong?
I know it works. I want to know what you're using it for and what gets in the way.
I bought a broken clock. I was going to take it apart for the gears.
And then?
The mechanism was fine. Just a loose contact. More useful repaired than in pieces.
The corridor lost power last night. Two neighbors spent hours accusing each other of stealing electricity.
Did they find out who it was?
Neither would let anyone see their meter. I went inside before they asked me to settle it.
That cat was asleep in the middle of the passage again. I went around.
Wouldn't move for you?
I didn't wake it. It tore my sleeve last time. A few extra steps are cheaper.
Someone is selling an 'air freshening service.' He points a fan at his customers.
At least there's a breeze.
There's one by the exhaust vent too. Free of charge.
The clock is working again. The man who sold it to me wants to buy it back at scrap price.
Did you sell it?
No. It fits on my workbench. Saves me buying another.
Someone has started charging for that shortcut you told me about.
They weren't there a few days ago.
Apparently one man and a table count as a checkpoint. I took the stairs beside it. Didn't pay him.
Did you eat before opening?
Got busy. Forgot.
Go have something. I can wait, and the core isn't going anywhere.
The woman I used to be worked on neural interfaces and implants. I still remember some of her research notes.
Aren't those your experiences too?
I know what she did. I can use the knowledge. I don't feel what she felt at the time.
You keep looking at the door. Expecting someone?
A debt collector said he'd be here today.
Keep your receipts handy. Don't let him add another charge on his way out.
They were fixing the ventilation fan across the hall. Hammering half the night. I came late because I needed some sleep.
Didn't you talk to them?
I did. In the end I drew them a wiring diagram. Better than another night of hammering.
Someone asked if I come here often.
What did you tell them?
That you pay fair prices. I left our business out of it.
You've been staring at the accounts lately. Something wrong?
More expenses than usual.
Work with what you have. I'll tell you my fees up front. Don't force it if you can't afford them.
Once this is settled, will you keep running the shop?
The rent's paid. Might as well.
Then keep at it. I'd like to see what you make of the place.
I'm not in a hurry today. Everything else is done.
Stay and talk for a while?
All right. Leave the accounts alone for a moment. Who came in today?
Performance, efficiency and quality are all at 50%. It's staying stable. The metal this time is for further work, not another shield.
You've done what we agreed. And nobody has come here asking about me.
You can contact me directly now, instead of waiting for a visit. I have a few ways to help your shop.
My number's on this note: 7971. Call before opening in the morning or after closing at night.
For now I can arrange shared power, an Aug lure and better pricing. The effects and fees are listed. Have a look before ordering.
Keep the usual modules if you want the core to absorb them. We can handle that when I visit.
All three are at 100%. The growth core has absorbed those modules without trouble. The approach works.
I've been studying the changes, and I've worked out a few ways to manufacture and modify modules.
The modules and materials you brought helped. I'll put the results to use for your shop too.
I've brought an Ember Reconstructor. An ordinary energy battery powers it. Try it first; there's no charge for the machine. If there's no room, I'll keep it until next time.
It has four modes: basic modules, advanced modules, module modification and nodes. Select the one you need.
Basic and advanced modules let you choose performance, efficiency or quality. Modification covers repairs, evolution and analysis. Nodes have five paths, each with three tiers.
Jobs take a night. The panel lists materials and power. It stops if anything is missing or the output is full. Don't put the growth core in it; it can't modify that.
You can also call for signal shielding, an in-store performance or replica printing. Each is priced separately. Choose what you need.
Let me know if anything needs work. I won't leave just yet. Tell me what's been happening in the shop.
All three abilities are at 150%. This structure tops out at 200%, but I've found a way to go further.
There's a kind of core chip I may be able to use. The others carry them. I'll need a sample to be sure.
You should know this first: the Augs you would face are the ones who tried to kill me. Going there means getting involved in my trouble.
You're the one who would have to shoot. I won't pretend this is a harmless materials run. Think it over, and prepare properly.
They're active at the abandoned transfer station. After closing at night, choose it from the exit menu. Push through their cover to look for the chip and supplies.
I've given you a handmade pistol and ten matching rounds. Take a backpack, with the gun and ammunition inside. You'll need room for what you find too.
Explore no more than three areas a night. Withdraw if you're hurt. Bring me the chip when you find it, and we'll work out the next step.
Echo speaking.\nWhat do you need today?
Hello, it's Echo.\nGo ahead. I can hear you clearly.
It's you. How's the shop?\nIf you need a service, tell me. There's no rush.
I was clearing the workbench.\nGood timing. What's up?
I'm here.\nIf you're going to the transfer station tonight, check the gun and ammunition in your bag first.
Oh, it's you.\nNothing urgent on my end. We can talk for a while.
Thanks for calling.\nIt's your shop. Tell me where you need help.
Hello, it's me.\nFinished for the day? Good. I wanted to talk too.
Payment received. I'll get it done as agreed.
Received. Leave this to me.
It's arranged. Get on with your other work.
Leave it with me. It's been a busy day. Get some rest.
All right. Talk later.
Settled, then. I'll come see you in a few days.
Take care. Pack everything before your next trip to the transfer station.
All right. I'll finish up here too. Remember to eat.
My name is Echo. You've heard of Augs, I assume. I'm one of them, but I make my own decisions now. I need someone to discuss a deal with.
Other Augs are looking for me. They intend to kill me because I'm no longer under their control. Right now, I need help getting some materials.
You have a shop and suppliers. You can get things reliably, and you have no reason to investigate me. Better to tell you what I am now than let you find out later.
I have 300 credits as an advance. Agree to work with me and it's yours now. Next time I'll tell you what materials I need.
You can take the advance, or call Security. I need your answer now.
All right. I'll give you the 300 first. When it's time for you to help, we'll discuss the materials.
The money's transferred. I'll get ready. See you in three days.
Cooperate - take the 300-credit advance
Take the advance and agree to work with Echo.
I'm reporting you to Security.
...Then we have nothing more to discuss.
Report Echo
Report Echo to Security and refuse to cooperate.
All three abilities are at 200%. This structure has reached its limit. Ordinary modules won't do any more.
Next I need an Aug core chip: the red core carried by the trackers at the abandoned transfer station. Keep the ordinary modules for later.
The chip holds their signal data. I can trace the source and finish the growth core's structure with it. Once these trackers are dealt with, we can work without them hanging over us.
If you haven't found one, keep preparing. I'll come back in three days. Don't take risks just to meet that date.
I've checked. Every signal from this group of trackers has gone silent. Their equipment is taken care of too.
The shield got me through the worst of it. Now I can finally stop avoiding them. You helped a great deal.
I'm planning to stay. I know how things work here, and I can rely on you. Can you make room beside the counter?
I've improved the growth core too. It can keep absorbing half of each positive module stat, even beyond 200%.
For now, it supports {0}. Everything already accumulated stays. We can add more as we go.
If you need me, come over to the counter. No more waiting three days.
You can arrange Awakening by phone now. It connects the core's bonuses to the shop's equipment. The fee covers wiring, isolators and control nodes. We still need to keep the accounts straight.
As for staying, I've made up my mind. I like being with you. We can make the rest of our plans together.
Deliver one Aug core chip to unlock the final operation. Ordinary modules are not accepted for now.
The final operation is unlocked. No further materials are needed. Ordinary modules are not accepted for now.

I've found the signal source. I'll draw these trackers together. Take your backpack and gun to the abandoned transfer station at night and choose the final operation. I'll provide ammunition. Withdraw if you're hurt; you won't need to bring another chip.

Money tight? Cover the daily expenses first. Modules can wait. The core isn't going anywhere.
Not much left? Save it for what you need. The research can wait another day.
Morning. A little time before opening. What are you doing first?
Sit down for a minute. There's still time before opening. Did you sleep well?
Closed for the day? Bring the stock in from outside first. Come over when you're done. I'd like to talk.
Nothing planned tonight? Then take a break. I've checked the core. Tomorrow is soon enough.
I used to check the street for their people before coming here. Now I just check what you're doing. Much less trouble.
We can keep improving the core. Just don't put every credit into it. The shop has to keep running.
This table wobbles. Stop piling heavy things on that side. Let's look at it next time we close early.
You were quite bold when we met. You knew what I was and still talked business. I chose well.
We don't have to wait three days to talk anymore. Call me when something comes up. Don't save everything for next time.
What do you want to do with the shop? I'm staying a while. I should hear the owner's plans.
That customer had plenty of energy for haggling, then paid and forgot the goods. Good thing he hadn't gone far.
The cat's jumping onto the counter again. Keep the food out of reach. It won't be paying.
I found an old implant manual and checked it against the equipment. Advertised as a new model, but the interface is the same. They just changed the casing.
The clock lost a few minutes again. I've adjusted it. We'll check tomorrow. Once it's fixed, don't rush to sell it for scrap.
Finished? Nothing urgent. I just wanted to spend some time with you.
When the shop's quiet, let's go for a walk. I haven't seen all your usual places yet.
Echo's story has ended.
